name: Astraea Bound Collection Stock — reordered assembly
intended_use: Static reusable shelf stock: ten mutually supported upright volumes plus one crown-supported leaning volume and two weighted bookstops

resource_api.placement_origin: Actual shelf/book base Z0; row near centred at X0, with rear edges Y .11
resource_api.animation: None; one static mesh with semantic material primitives
resource_api.instancing: Reuse same imported mesh/material resources. Separate selected volumes only in future interaction work

authoring: Reproducible script-assisted intentional construction; separately editable covers, pages, labels, bands, bookstops, cover leaves and printed leaf surfaces
provenance: New original 2026-10-02 catalogue work, independent of missing game recovery. Four library reference PNGs inspected for collection rhythm and useful reading details only; no copied pixels or book art; no downloaded models; no Tripo.
qa_scope: Blender component evidence only; original game, Godot integration, actor acceptance, collision behavior and runtime performance are untested

export.geometry: One static visual mesh consolidated into semantic material primitives

assembly_variant.description: All eleven original volumes retained. Tall first binding and supported lean remain together; remaining ten-volume order is deliberately changed.
